svg.title: SIDERIUS — agent loop illustration
svg.desc: Illustration on a dotted journal page: a small cat-eared robot stands at the centre of a loop of four inked circles — a star for the question, a bar chart for the experiment, a falling curve for the score and a magnifier with a tick for the validity check — joined by dashed arrows. A waveform feeds the loop from the lower left; a hanging エージェント sign and a paper lantern sit in light rain on the right, and a round 検証済 stamp marks the lower right corner.
